predictions.articleTitle: Córdoba II vs Ceuta II Tactical Breakdown & Match Analysis: Away Scoring Drought Meets Coaching Shift
predictions.coreRecommendation: Poisson modeling and seasonal goal metrics point to a tight, low-margin contest favoring Draw / Away Win alongside Under 2.5 total goals.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Match Result — Draw / Away Win: Independent Poisson probabilities (39.7% Away Win, 26.2% Draw) and 1.25 vs 1.37 goal lambdas favor covering the stalemate alongside a narrow Ceuta II victory (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)

Total Goals — Under 2.5: Combined seasonal scoring of 2.30 goals per match and a 51.4% baseline probability for two or fewer goals support a restrained scoring script (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Correct Score Hedge — 1:1 / 0:1: The top two Poisson scorelines (12.5% and 10.0%) capture both the cagey stalemate and a single-goal road success (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)
